debtor_country_code.description: The debtor's two-letter country code in ISO 3166 format.

issuer_country_code.description: The issuer's two-letter country code in ISO 3166 format.

face_value.description: The invoice face value can only include numbers and dot (.) must be presented in (EUR) or pence (GBP). For example, 100.00 EUR .

due_date.description: The due date as shown on the potential invoice to be financed. Should be in format YYYY-MM-DD, for example, 2022-01-01.
